acceleration_on_acquisition.source_text:
Acceleration on acquisition
50% of Unvested Options vest on a Change of
Control

exercise_window_days.source_text:
Exercise Window after leaving
90 days after the Last Working Day

leaver_terms.source_text: If you leave as a Good Leaver, your Unvested Options lapse on your Last Working Day, and you may exercise your Vested Options within 90 days after your Last Working Day. If you are a Bad Leaver, you forfeit all Vested and Unvested Options.

vesting_frequency.source_text:
Vesting after the Cliff
Monthly, in equal instalments

33d088bd65cd6ff159804dfe9a6076b254d92185.text:
[F1] The letter grants 3,000 options, which is within the policy limit of up to 989,950 options.  
[F2] The exercise price set in the letter is Rs 15, meeting the policy minimum of Rs 10.  
[F3] The grant date of 1 October 2026 complies with the policy requirement of being on or after 15 November 2024.  
[F4] The cliff period of 12 months in the letter matches the policy’s 12‑month requirement.  
[F5] The total vesting period of 48 months aligns with the policy’s 48‑month requirement.  
[F6] The monthly vesting frequency stated in the letter satisfies the policy’s monthly requirement.  
[F7] The 90‑day exercise window after leaving specified in the letter meets the policy’s 90‑day requirement.  
[F8] The letter provides acceleration of 50 % of unvested options on acquisition, as required by policy.  
[F9] The letter states that unvested options lapse on leaving, which is consistent with policy.  
[F10] The letter confirms that a bad leaver forfeits vested options, as required by policy.

55bb23b2c51e56a2c241a5cb0fec110d48b310b4.text:
[F1] The letter grants 3,000 options, which is within the unallocated pool limit of 989,950 options. 
[F2] The exercise price in the letter is Rs 15, which meets the required minimum of Rs 10. 
[F3] The grant date is 1 October 2026, which is on or after the required date of 15 November 2024. 
[F4] The cliff period is 12 months, matching the required 12 months. 
[F5] The total vesting period is 48 months, as required. 
[F6] Vesting occurs monthly, as required. 
[F7] The exercise window after leaving is 90 days, as required. 
[F8] Acceleration on acquisition is 50% of unvested options, as required. 
[F9] Unvested options lapse upon leaving, as required. 
[F10] Bad leavers forfeit vested options, as required.
